fact: A hand count of 1,209 Google Maps reviews of 27 Front Range artificial turf business listings, captured September 24, 2026 and dated from about 2012 to September 2026, found 1,141 rated 5 out of 5, 9 rated 4, 4 rated 3, 8 rated 2 and 47 rated 1.
quote: I’m left wondering how representative some of their glowing five-star reviews really are.
source_label: Google Maps reviews of 27 Front Range artificial turf business listings, captured 2026-09-24; hand count by NoCo Turf Co., 2026-09-25 (businesses not named)
notes: Counted by hand 2026-09-25 from the captured copy archive/research-2026-09-24/data/voc__corpus.json (1,209 rows; Google Maps pages loaded in headless Chromium on 2026-09-24, every review expanded). Google Maps does not serve review text to automated fetches (re-tried 2026-09-25), so this is EXTERNAL_SOURCE and reachable false: re-count by hand in a browser before publishing. Dates are approximate years converted from Maps' relative dates. Derived: 1,150 rated 4 or 5; 59 rated 3 or lower; 55 of 1,209 is fewer than 1 in 20. General landscapers were counted only where a review mentions turf, artificial, synthetic, fake grass or putting. No NoCo Turf Co. review is in the set. The quote is one reviewer in the set (corpus idx 1177) doubting a listing's ratings, kept as the survivorship caveat. Recount before publishing: the set changes as reviews are added.

fact: Of those reviews, 260 are of 13 Northern Colorado business listings, 256 of them rated 5 and 4 rated 1, and 949 are of 14 listings elsewhere on the Front Range, 51 of them rated 1 or 2.
quote: No call no show for appointment
source_label: Google Maps reviews of 13 Northern Colorado and 14 other Front Range artificial turf business listings, captured 2026-09-24; hand count by NoCo Turf Co., 2026-09-25 (businesses not named)
notes: Split by the corpus's noco flag (27 place slugs: 13 true, 14 false). Six of the 13 Northern Colorado listings are general landscapers counted only for turf mentions. One Northern Colorado listing is on the Weld County edge outside the NoCo town list; it is counted as Northern Colorado, as the research file did. Quote: corpus idx 794.

fact: None of the 4 low ratings of Northern Colorado listings is about installed turf: they concern a cancelled site visit, a missed appointment, a late crew the owner then cancelled, and a fence job whose reviewer praised the turf.
quote: This company does solid work with turf
source_label: Google Maps reviews of 13 Northern Colorado artificial turf business listings, captured 2026-09-24; hand count by NoCo Turf Co., 2026-09-25 (businesses not named)
notes: Corpus idx 1177 (same-day cancellation of a site review), 794 (no-show), 826 (late twice; owner cancelled), 788 (fence job; quote from this review).

fact: Of the 59 reviews rated 3 or lower, 55 are complaints: 22 about unanswered calls, missed or late appointments, or quotes and samples that never came; 3 from buyers who paid and never got the job; 19 about turf already in the ground; 7 about buying turf or supplies; and 4 about other matters.
quote: Was told I would get a quote the following day.
source_label: Google Maps reviews of 27 Front Range artificial turf business listings, captured 2026-09-24; complaints coded by hand by NoCo Turf Co., 2026-09-25 (businesses not named)
notes: Not complaints (4): idx 37, 438, 462 (praise filed under a low rating), 609 (a truck sale). Before any work (22): 358, 414, 468, 507, 557, 568, 573, 589, 599, 607, 658, 794, 826, 958, 995, 1058, 1086, 1091, 1101, 1102, 1104, 1177. Paid, no job (3): 481, 482, 671. Turf in the ground (19): 509, 532, 538, 562, 593, 598, 611, 613, 629, 630, 643, 667, 669, 782 (DIY), 905, 1044, 1069, 1112, 1131. Buying turf or supplies (7): 550, 575, 775, 776, 777, 778 (four reviews from one contractor crew about one short order), 972. Other (4): 93 (environmental objection), 542 (price), 696 (a former worker), 788 (fence job). Coding is one reader's judgment; each review sits in one stage. Quote: idx 1086.

fact: Of the 19 complaints about turf in the ground, 13 say the fix was slow or never came, 8 say the job was built differently from what was sold, 4 cite dog urine odor or stains, 4 visible seams, 3 drainage or standing water, 2 an uneven surface, 2 loose turf, 2 window-reflection melt and 2 weeds, and 3 blame the turf product itself.
quote: the installation process did not follow what I was told from our sales representative
source_label: Google Maps reviews of 27 Front Range artificial turf business listings, captured 2026-09-24; complaints coded by hand by NoCo Turf Co., 2026-09-25 (businesses not named)
notes: One review can carry several failures. Slow or no fix (13): 509, 532, 538, 562, 593, 611, 613, 629, 630, 669, 905, 1044, 1069. Built differently from what was sold (8): 532 (base material), 562 (weed barrier), 593 (weed barrier, seam count), 598 (foam pad skipped until the owner noticed), 630 (different turf, infill), 643 (plan changed), 667 (crew ignored the written directions), 1069 (area short). Odor or stains (4): 611, 613, 630, 1112. Seams (4): 593, 629, 630, 1131. Drainage (3): 532, 611, 630. Uneven (2): 532, 905. Loose (2): 532, 1044. Window melt (2): 509, 782. Weeds (2): 562, 593. Product blamed (3): 611, 613 (pet backing held urine), 1112 (yellow stains). Quote: idx 562.

fact: In one complaint, a new-build yard with a small swale flooded for almost 3 days after the first moisture because the promised permeable crushed-granite base was swapped for a powdery material, and the owner later planned to remove the turf.
quote: flooding and has remained that way for almost 3 days now
source_label: Google Maps review of a Front Range artificial turf installer, rated 1 out of 5, about 2018, captured 2026-09-24 (business not named)
notes: Corpus idx 532. The review's update says the turf was wrinkling off the base and would be removed in the spring.

fact: One dog owner's complaint says the turf smelled of urine on any warm day above 70°F, after the installer had replaced it once.
quote: On any warm day above 70°F, my front and back yards smell like a sewer.
source_label: Google Maps review of a Front Range artificial turf installer, rated 1 out of 5, about 2026, captured 2026-09-24 (business not named)
notes: Corpus idx 611. The reviewer blames a pet backing that did not drain; the turf was replaced once and the smell returned.

fact: A dog owner who rated the install 5 out of 5 sprays an enzyme cleaner every 2 weeks in summer to keep the urine smell down, rather than the every 3 months first suggested, at about $50 a bottle.
quote: spraying every 2 weeks to keep the smell down during these hot summer months
source_label: Google Maps review of a Front Range artificial turf installer, rated 5 out of 5, about 2024, captured 2026-09-24 (business not named)
notes: Corpus idx 1045 (edited review; the source writes the price as 50$ a bottle). A second 5-rated dog owner (idx 280) rinses daily with 3 dogs in dry, hot stretches.

fact: One reviewer noticed seam lines after the first winter, and the installer ended up replacing the entire turf at no charge.
quote: After our first winter, we noticed some seam lines with our initial turf installation
source_label: Google Maps review of a Front Range artificial turf installer, rated 5 out of 5, about 2025, captured 2026-09-24 (business not named)

fact: Three reviewers describe turf melted by sunlight reflected off their windows, one of them within 2 weeks of install and then paying $800 for window tint, and a fourth praises an installer who raised the window risk before any turf went down.
quote: within 2 weeks of having the grass installed, we had two burn lines
source_label: Google Maps reviews of Front Range artificial turf businesses, captured 2026-09-24 (businesses not named)
notes: Melt: idx 509 (2 out of 5; the reviewer writes that the tint cost an additional $800 and that the melt was excluded), 782 (1 out of 5, DIY; the reviewer writes that the seller's written terms did not cover reflection melt), 344 (5 out of 5; film, then the turf replaced). Warned before install: idx 290. Quote: idx 509.

fact: Five reviewers describe turf that settled, sank or held water after install, from small patches within months to sinking after 4 years, and two of those yards were new builds.
quote: It’s been 4 years now and we have some sinking.
source_label: Google Maps reviews of Front Range artificial turf businesses, captured 2026-09-24 (businesses not named)
notes: Corpus idx 532 (swale flooding, 1 out of 5), 580 (patches settled within months, fixed, 5), 631 (sinking after 4 years, installer missed the visit, 4), 910 (settling on a new property, fixed, 5), 911 (small sink fixed, 5). Quote: idx 631.

fact: At least 8 reviews rated 4 or 5 describe a second company fixing, finishing or advising on turf work a first company did badly or left undone, including a putting green, a dog run and turf laid by a stonework contractor, and 2 of them are of Northern Colorado listings.
quote: his company had no experience installing turf
source_label: Google Maps reviews of Front Range artificial turf businesses, captured 2026-09-24 (businesses not named)
notes: Corpus idx 194 (Northern Colorado; first installer would not fix, a neighbor's installer advised), 303 (dog run stinky and torn after a poor install), 392 (finished work another company abandoned), 535 (poorly installed putting green redone), 592 (installation ruined, repaired), 602 (sprinkler left uncapped, sinkhole), 914 (failed multi-use putting course and court), 982 (Northern Colorado; stonework contractor laid the turf). Found by keyword search and reading; a full read could find more, hence 'at least'. Quote: idx 982.

fact: In one complaint, the owner's landscape architect asked for a site visit for about a week after the turf pulled up with nails showing, and no one came.
quote: Our landscape architect has reached out on numerous occasions to request a site visit
source_label: Google Maps review of a Front Range artificial turf installer, rated 1 out of 5, about 2025, captured 2026-09-24 (business not named)

fact: At least 8 reviews rated 5 describe a seam, melt spot, weed problem or settled patch that the installer came back and fixed, including one owner who wrote 3 months in that they were regretting the decision.
quote: 3 months in - we’re regretting the decision.
source_label: Google Maps reviews of Front Range artificial turf businesses, captured 2026-09-24 (businesses not named)
notes: Corpus idx 1015 (seam lines after the first winter, full replacement), 1111 (showing seam fixed within 2 hours), 344 (window melt, film, turf replaced), 1026 (weeds within 3 months, commercial weed barrier and reinstall at no cost), 580 (settled patches filled), 911 (small sink fixed), 910 (new-property settling fixed), 789 (minor installation issue handled). Quote: idx 1026.

fact: At least 12 reviewers say they wish they had put turf in sooner, and 3 describe hiring for turf a second time, 2 of them at a new house.
quote: My only regret is that I did not do this sooner.
source_label: Google Maps reviews of Front Range artificial turf businesses, captured 2026-09-24 (businesses not named)

fact: Of the 1,150 reviews rated 4 or 5, 24 mention turf samples and 6 credit the installer with the HOA side, such as knowing the rules, the edging the HOA asked for, or help at the HOA meeting.
quote: knowledgeable on our HOA policies which helped us easily develop a plan
source_label: Google Maps reviews of 27 Front Range artificial turf business listings, captured 2026-09-24; hand count by NoCo Turf Co., 2026-09-25 (businesses not named)
notes: Samples: keyword 'sample' in 24 reviews rated 4 or 5, each read. HOA credit: idx 181, 234, 635, 642, 692, 1206 (idx 1122, 1124 and 1133 mention an HOA without crediting the installer). Quote: idx 181.

fact: None of the 1,209 reviews mentions hail or PFAS, and no review rated 3 or lower complains about the turf's surface heat.
quote: While it does get hot, it’s cooler than the tiles underneath
source_label: Google Maps reviews of 27 Front Range artificial turf business listings, captured 2026-09-24; keyword search by NoCo Turf Co., 2026-09-25 (businesses not named)
notes: Searched every review for hail, PFAS, hot, heat and temperature. The turf-heat mentions (idx 280, 727, 1005) are all rated 5 out of 5. Window-reflection melt is counted separately. Quote: idx 727.
